Immerse yourself in *Se numea Sarah*, a deeply moving work of historical fiction by Tatiana de Rosnay. This novel masterfully intertwines personal tragedy with sweeping moments of history, offering readers an unforgettable look at life under the Nazi occupation of France. If you are searching for compelling WWII literature or stories rooted in real-life human struggle, this book is essential reading.

***

## About *Se numea Sarah*

The narrative unfolds across decades, connecting two lives separated by time but united by a terrible secret:

**Paris, July 1942:** Meet Sarah, an intelligent Jewish girl of ten years old. During the darkest days of the occupation, she is arrested from her home in Paris alongside her parents by French police. Determined to help her brother, she manages to hide him in their secret hiding place, believing she will be free soon enough to rescue the family.

Tatiana de Rosnay takes us into the heart of occupied France, stripping away the silence that surrounded this difficult subjectâa story that remains both deeply personal and historically monumental. The novel doesn't just recount history; it compels readers to feel the weight of memory itself.
